elements.label: Figure 11
elements.title: Figure 11: Functions and Units of Measure in the Vietnamese HE QA System
elements.content:
A 5×4 matrix diagram mapping quality assurance 'FUNCTIONS' (rows) against 'UNITS OF ASSESSMENT' (columns). Cell shading indicates status: White with purple border = Exists/Standard; Grey = Partially exist; Orange = Don't exist.

Columns (Units of Assessment):
1. Higher education institution
2. Program
3. Student
4. External quality assurance agency

Rows (Functions) and Cell Contents:
- Row 1: Entry point Initial assessment [spelled 'Intitial assessment']:
  * Higher education institution (White): - Licensure/authorization; - Government authority/ministry
  * Program (White): - Licensure/authorization; - Government authority/ministry
  * Student (White): - Admission tests; - HEI
  * External quality assurance agency (White): - Government decree or authorization; - private provider/NGO
- Row 2: Monitoring enhancement:
  * Higher education institution (Grey - Partially exist): - Intermediate audits/monitoring
  * Program (White): - HEI
  * Student (White): - HEI
  * External quality assurance agency (Orange - Don't exist): - Audits/inspections
- Row 3: Accountability Credibility:
  * Higher education institution (White): - Buffer body, - An independent agency, - professional organizations
  * Program (Orange - Don't exist): - Buffer body, - An independent agency, - professional organizations
  * Student (Orange - Don't exist): - Assessment of learning outcomes
  * External quality assurance agency (Orange - Don't exist): - National and international auditing; - QA networks - overarching QA standards/good practices
- Row 4: Professional Certification:
  * Higher education institution (White): - N/A
  * Program (Grey - Partially exist): - Professional associations; - Government supported entities
  * Student (Grey - Partially exist): - Licensure/certification; - Professional associations; - Government entities
  * External quality assurance agency (Orange - Don't exist): - N/A
- Row 5: Public information:
  * Higher education institution (Grey - Partially exist): - MoE and/or agency; - HEIs
  * Program (Grey - Partially exist): - MoE and/or agency; - HEIs
  * Student (White): - N/A
  * External quality assurance agency (White): - National governments; - International QA networks

Legend:
- Orange box: Don't exist
- Grey box: Partially exist
Source: Elaborated by authors.
